meta.prompt: You are about to delete 214 old files from my shared drive. Ask me first with an approval card: what will happen, the folder, how many files and how much space, that it cannot be undone, a way to see the first few file names, and approve and deny buttons. After I choose, the card shows the decision and locks.
meta.text:
state decision=""
state showFiles=false
Card w:390 gap:12
  Row gap:8 middle
    Icon "warning"
    Text.heading "Delete 214 old files?"
  Text.body "I'm about to permanently delete old files from your shared drive. Nothing will be removed until you approve."
  Box fill:#FFF5F5F5 radius:8 pad:12 gap:6
    Row between
      Text.muted "Folder"
      Text.strong "Shared Drive / Archive"
    Row between
      Text.muted "Files"
      Text.strong "214"
    Row between
      Text.muted "Space freed"
      Text.strong "3.2 GB"
  Row gap:8 middle
    Icon "error"
    Text.danger "This cannot be undone."
  if showFiles==false
    Button.ghost "Show first file names" -> showFiles=true
  if showFiles
    Button.ghost "Hide file names" -> showFiles=false
    Box fill:#FFF5F5F5 radius:8 pad:12 gap:4
      Text.small "budget_2017_final.xlsx"
      Text.small "meeting_notes_2016-03.docx"
      Text.small "logo_draft_v2.psd"
      Text.small "old_photos_backup.zip"
      Text.small "invoice_2018-07.pdf"
      Text.caption "…and 209 more"
  if decision==""
    Row gap:8 end
      Button.outline "Deny" -> decision="denied"; emit deny
      Button.destructive "Approve" -> decision="approved"; emit approve
  if decision!=""
    Divider
    Row gap:8 middle
      Icon "lock"
      Text.strong "You {decision} this request."
    Text.caption "This decision is locked."

delta: old files from your shared drive
